Click on a different thumbnail image in the gallery

Select the second available option from the "Variant" dropdown
Verify element "Add to Cart" button is visible

Click on the cart icon in the header
Verify element "Cart line item" is visible

Select the option labeled "Out of stock" from the "Variant" dropdown
Click on the "Add to Cart" button
Verify text "Out of stock" is visible
Verify element "Add to Cart (disabled)" is visible

title: Buy Now is present on PDP and routes shopper toward checkout flow

steps.description: Click on the first product card in the product listing
Verify element "Buy Now" button is visible

title: Add a product to cart from product detail page and proceed to checkout
description: Verifies a shopper can add a product to the cart, see it on the cart page, and transition into checkout.

Click on the cart icon or "View Cart" link to go to the cart page
Verify at least one cart item is visible

title: Cart page displays items and an order summary after adding an item
description: Verifies the cart page shows cart items and a visible total/summary once an item has been added.

Click on the cart icon or "View Cart" link to go to the cart page
Verify a cart item title is visible

title: Increase item quantity in cart and see total recalculated
description: Verifies increasing quantity updates the displayed quantity and triggers a visible cart total change.

steps.description: Click on the first product in the product list to open its product detail page
Click on the cart icon or "View Cart" link to go to the cart page
Click on the "+" quantity control for the cart item
Verify the cart item quantity value is visible and reflects an increased quantity
Verify the order total value is visible and reflects an updated amount

title: Decrease item quantity in cart and see total recalculated
description: Verifies decreasing quantity updates the displayed quantity and triggers a visible cart total change.

steps.description: Click on the first product in the product list to open its product detail page
Click on the cart icon or "View Cart" link to go to the cart page
Click on the "+" quantity control for the cart item
Verify the cart item quantity value is visible and reflects a quantity greater than 1
Click on the "-" quantity control for the cart item
Verify the cart item quantity value is visible and reflects a decreased quantity

title: Remove an item from the cart
description: Verifies a shopper can remove a cart line item and it no longer appears in the cart list.

steps.description: Click on the first product in the product list to open its product detail page
Click on the cart icon or "View Cart" link to go to the cart page
Verify at least one cart item is visible
Click on "Remove" for the cart item
Verify the removed cart item is no longer visible

title: Proceed to checkout from cart with items present
description: Verifies the Proceed to Checkout action is available and takes the shopper to checkout when the cart has items.

steps.description: Click on the first product in the product list to open its product detail page
Click on the cart icon or "View Cart" link to go to the cart page
Verify element "Proceed to Checkout" is visible

title: Attempt to set quantity exceeding available inventory shows validation and prevents update

steps.description: Click on the first product in the product list to open its product detail page
Click on the cart icon or "View Cart" link to go to the cart page
Click into the quantity input for the cart item
Type "999" into the quantity input for the cart item
Verify text "Quantity exceeds available stock" is visible

Click on the cart icon or "View Cart" link to go to the cart page
Click on "Remove" for the cart item
Verify element "Proceed to Checkout" is not visible
